title: pellionia angularis

This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Pellionia angularis, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are also responsible for its potential therapeutic actions, including antibacterial and anti-cancer properties.
